quicksort.title_fragment: recursive calls are outside the first LLVM subset
quicksort.detail_fragment: `quicksort_range` participates in a recursive call cycle
quicksort.closure: The exact verified quicksort closure is recursive; the native gate rejects recursive call cycles before code generation.

merge.title_fragment: construct is outside the current LLVM backend subset
merge.detail_fragment: function parameter type `&[i32]` has no LLVM value representation
merge.closure: The exact merge kernel passes borrowed i32 arrays; the native ABI currently admits borrowed u32 and bool arrays only.

hashmap.title_fragment: class is outside the exact scalar-owner LLVM subset
hashmap.closure: The exact map is a monomorphized generic class with owned array fields, outside the private concrete integer-field scalar-owner class subset.

lomuto_partition_u32.scope: Exact non-recursive Lomuto partition kernel over admitted u32 arrays; excludes recursive quicksort.
lomuto_partition_u32.noncomparable_reason: Clang -O2 precomputes the fixed-input partition and output oracle in both emitted Sable LLVM and C, so the surviving loop measures allocation, constant stores, release, and counting rather than the partition algorithm.

merge_u32.scope: Full merge control/data algorithm over admitted u32 arrays; excludes the canonical borrowed i32 ABI.

linear_probe_u32.scope: Fixed-capacity local-u32-array probing algorithm; excludes the canonical generic class and u64-value representation.
